# Seconds per cmd/monoagentcli top-level test (subtests included), used by monoagentcli-shard.sh
# to balance the four monoagentcli test shards. Measured 2026-11-06 on a 24-core box under nokc.sh:
# every test that takes 0.25 s or more without -race (181 of 804) was run with -race
# (`go test -race -json -run ...`, in batches, its elapsed seconds); every other test carries its
# non-race `go test -json` seconds times the median race/non-race ratio of the measured ones
# (about 21), at least 1. The earlier 2026-11-03 numbers were wrong by up to two orders of magnitude
# (shard 0 ran 42 min in CI while the others ran 15-30 min). CI runs about 1.6x these seconds.
# Only the relative sizes matter. A test missing from this file weighs the median of the file.
# Refresh occasionally: nothing breaks if it goes stale, the split just drifts.
